newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish budget deficit up to PLN 6.15 bln in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Polish budget deficit up to PLN 6.15 bln in Sept.

text.p: Polish budget deficit widened by 606 million to 6.15 billion zlotys in September, which accounted for 60.5 percent of the planned 1996 deficit of 10.16 billion zlotys, the finance ministry said.
In August, the treasury increased its planned 1996 budget gap by 659 million zlotys to 10.159 billion after taking into account foreign loans for restructuring of state-owned firms.
